summary: 5 Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for AWS Impact.
description: Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for AWS targeting the Impact tactic. Each script invokes the official Stratus binary using an isolated Morgana correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation. Prerequisite cloud infrastructure is managed by Stratus warmup. Cleanup is performed via the separate cleanup_command using the same correlation ID.
purpose: Validate AWS Impact detection rules, SIEM alerts, and SOC workflows in an authorized cloud sandbox.
capabilities: 5 Stratus Red Team techniques for AWS Impact.
Official Stratus binary execution — no custom attack code.
Morgana Test ID used as Stratus correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation.
Separate detonate + cleanup lifecycle with state preservation.
use_cases: Validate AWS Impact detection in an authorized cloud sandbox.
Exercise SIEM, CSPM, cloud-native detection, and SOC workflows with real cloud API activity.
Confirm detection rules fire on real technique execution before incident response exercises.
prerequisites: AWS credentials configured on the Agent (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET, AWS_PROFILE, or IAM instance profile).
IAM permissions appropriate for the techniques being tested.
Authorized test AWS account — never run against production workloads.
safety_notes: Stratus Red Team is designed for authorized sandbox cloud environments only.
Never execute against production cloud accounts, subscriptions, or clusters.
Some techniques create real cloud resources that incur cost — always run cleanup after detonation.
Warmup may take 1–5 minutes for Terraform-based infrastructure setup.
Cleanup uses the same correlation ID; ensure MORGANA_TEST_ID matches the detonation Test.
author: Datadog / Stratus Red Team

scripts.name: STRATUS - AWS - Invoke Bedrock Model
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for AWS.

Invoke Bedrock Model

Simulates an attacker enumerating Bedrock models and then invoking the

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Invoke Bedrock Model
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_profile}" ]; then export AWS_PROFILE="#{stratus_aws_profile}"; fi
if [ -n "#{stratus_aws_region}" ]; then export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="#{stratus_aws_region}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=aws.impact.bedrock-invoke-model"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate aws.impact.bedrock-invoke-model
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=aws.impact.bedrock-invoke-model"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"aws.impact.bedrock-invoke-model\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup aws.impact.bedrock-invoke-model
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=aws.impact.bedrock-invoke-model"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT

scripts.name: STRATUS - AWS - Deregister an Amazon EC2 AMI
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for AWS.

Deregister an Amazon EC2 AMI
